A fresh search today found a concessionaire alert confirming Phantom Ranch, including the canteen and all overnight lodging, remains closed through at least November 19, 2026 as part of a series of extensions, with no firm reopening date given by the National Park Service at this time (Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park; Grand Canyon Lodges concessionaire alerts). A planned Transcanyon Waterline Project closure between Redwall Bridge and Cottonwood Campground, originally set to begin October 15, 2026 and run through approximately February 2027, remains moot while the full-trail flood closure is in effect. Bright Angel and Cottonwood Campgrounds remain closed indefinitely.
